changes: New: BREAKCUT, Livecut's break cutting as a track machine for a sliced Flex break (SRC SETUP, like VECTOR).
ALGO picks CutProc11, WarpCut, SQPusher or MIX; ACTV sets how much it cuts, ROLL how often phrases end in a roll or fill; RAMP pitches rolls, REV reverses blocks; YES draws a new variation.
Writes real trigs with STRT, RTRG, RTIM, PTCH and RATE locks and micro-timing; the sequencer plays them.
Needs the Modwerk base loaded over USB (beta) and a break sliced one slice a step with SLIC on. Card firmware cannot include it.
Not yet tested on a unit or in the emulator; the slice, reverse and retrig-time values are to be read off the unit.
